definitions.explanation: A formally imposed restriction forbidding some activity. Standalone use is largely confined to set expressions; the kanji is more commonly seen in compounds such as {禁止|きんし} (prohibition) or {禁酒|きんしゅ} (abstaining from alcohol).

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{禁|きん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついに⟦{解|と}かれた→解く：02301_toku⟧。
examples.english: The long-standing ban was finally lifted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{特定|とくてい}→特定：04275_tokutei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{薬物|やくぶつ}→薬物：14053_yakubutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{禁|きん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{課|か}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The government has imposed a ban on certain drugs.

notes:
Mostly used in set expressions; everyday writing usually prefers the compound ⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {禁|きん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解|と}く→解く：02301_toku⟧: to lift a ban
- {禁|きん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{犯|おか}す→犯す：10059_okasu⟧: to violate a ban
- {禁|きん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{破|やぶ}る→破る：02321_yaburu⟧: to break a ban
- {禁|きん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{課|か}す: to impose a ban

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: prohibition (most common everyday term)
- ⟦{禁酒|きんしゅ}→禁酒：15803_kinshu⟧: abstaining from alcohol
- ⟦{禁煙|きんえん}→禁煙：02644_kinen⟧: no smoking; quitting smoking
